data.gender_notes: Rijvan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lotus that grows in the water
data.long_meaning: Rijvan is a Hindu name that means 'Lotus that grows in the water'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rij' which means 'lotus' and 'van' which means 'growing'. It symbolizes the ability to thrive in difficult conditions, just like the lotus that blooms in water. The name Rijvan carries the meaning “Lotus that grows in the water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rijvan usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus that grows in the water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rijvan is a powerful name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the divine lotus that grows in the mud of the material world, yet remains pure and untouched by it. This name is a reminder to stay connected to your spirituality, even in the midst of life's challenges.
data.etymology: Rijvan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus that grows in the water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rijvan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
